paite: Nang loh tuak ngeiloupi, alok a pang, lepchiahtak a bawl tuak ngeiloupi, lepchiahtak a pang, na tung agik hi. Mi loh na tawp hun chiang in nang leng loh na tuak sam ding hi; lepchiahtak a na hih khit chiang in, na tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih ding uhi.
heading: Panpihna Ngen a Thumna
english: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon hehpih in; ka hon ngak nilouh uhi; zingsang teng in ka ban uh hong hi inla, buai hun chiang in leng hon hondampa hong hi in.
english: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

paite: Lum vengvung husa in michih ataimangta ua; nang na kisak hial chiang in namte hihdalh in a-om uhi.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

paite: Na sum uh gallak a lak ding lung in thil anek dundun bang in nekgaih in a-om ding; khaupete atawm duamduam uh bang in amaute sum tung ah atawm duamduam ding uhi.
english: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

paite: Tunglam ah TOUPA tawisang in a-omta hi; ama'n Zion vaihawm diktak leh diktatna in adimsakta hi.
english: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

paite: Na damsung in omkipna a-om ding a, hotdamna, pilna, theihna a-om kikeih ding; TOUPA launa tuh agou ahi.
english: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.

paite: Ngai in, apasalphate uh polam ah akikou ua; kituahna palaite akap hawhaw uhi.
english: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

paite: Lamliante amualta ua, mizin vialvakte a-om nawn kei uh; ama'n thukhun abohsia a, khuate amusit a, mi khawk asa kei hi.
english: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

paite: Gam akap in agim a; Lebanon azum in avuai a; Sharon gamdai bang ahita; Bashan leh Karmel in anah uh asingkhia uhi.
english: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Tu'n ka thou ding a, tu'n ka kisa ding a, tu'n tawisang in ka omta ding.
heading: TOUPA'N Agalte Avauhilh
english: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

paite: Lou keu naupai in na pai ding ua, buhpawl na suang ding uh; na hu uh noumau kangmang ding mei ahi.
english: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

paite: Michih lah chinai suang hal bang, loulingnei vatsa mei a apaih bang uh, achi ding uh," achi hi.
english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

paite: Gamlapi a omte aw, ka thilhih bil in za un; naichik a omte aw, ka thilhihtheihdan thei un.
english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

paite: Zion a migilou omte'n alau ua; Pathian zah lou mite linna in amanta hi. I lak ua kua ahia thil katmang ching mei kiang a om ding? I lak uah kua ahia tangtawn a kang zoizoi kiang a om ding?
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

paite: Diktattak a om a, diktak a genmi; nuaisiahnate punna himhim bangmah a ngai lou a, golhna la nuam lou abil hum a, gilou himhim en nuam lou a mitsi zel.
english: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

paite: Huai mi tunglam ah a-om ding a; akidalna mun sang suangpi kidalnate ahi ding; akiang ah a-an piak ahi ding a, atuite a-om ngeingei ding hi.
english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

paite: Na mite'n kumpipa akilawmna in amu ding a, gam kiphalh zatak ahon en ding uhi.
heading: Tunung A Thupina Ding
english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

paite: Asimmi koi a omta ahia? Siahliau tehmi koi a-omta ahia? Galven insangte simmi koi a omta ahia? chi in na lungtang in thil mulkimhuai mahmah na ngaihtuah ding.
english: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

paite: Mihangtak, pau giltak na theihtheih louh a pau mite, pau tuam na theihsiam louh a pau mite, na mu nawnta kei ding.
english: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

paite: I zehtanna khopi Zion en dih; na mit in Jerusalem omna muanhuaitak, puanin chik mah chiang a leng suan louh ding, kaihgakna khet chik mah chiang a leng boh louh ding, akaihna khau himhim kitat lou ding bang, amu ding hi.
english: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA, lui za pipi leh luitate omna mun, thupitak in i kiang uah a-om zaw ding; huai tui tung ah kidouna long lianpi kalhna chiang neite apai kei ding a, long lian thupitak in leng akheng sam kei ding hi.
english: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

paite: TOUPA lah i vaihawmpa ahi a, TOUPA lah dan hon pepa ahi a, TOUPA lah i kumpipa ahi; ama'n ahon hondam ding hi.
english: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.

paite: Na khaute kolsak in a-om ding a; apuanzak peu bul uh akipsak thei kei ua, puanzak lah azak thei kei uh; huaitak in gallak sum tampi hawm in a-om a; khebaite'n leng gallak sum alata uhi.
english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

paite: Huai khua a mi om in, ka chi ana, achi kei ding a, asung a mite khelhna ngaihdam in a-om ding uhi.
english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
